plan.name: Keep git's upkeep from outliving the factory's git commands
plan.summary: What outlives the factory's calls is git's own upkeep: git fetch, git commit and the receive-pack a push runs start git gc --auto (git maintenance run --auto), which git runs in the background by default, so it can go on writing to the clone, or to the repository pushed to, after the call that ran git has returned and after Poll, Wait or WorkPlan says it's done. That is what wrote into origin.git while TestAPlanOpensItsIssuesOneAtATime's cleanup removed it, and it also breaks SPEC's promise that git commands on the watcher's clone run one at a time (D-0113). Every git command that Clone's methods in repo.go and runs.go run gets `-c gc.autoDetach=false -c maintenance.autoDetach=false` before its subcommand, so upkeep that's due runs before the command returns; every push (Push, PushCommit, and the pushes that record a run, its result or the lease) also passes `--receive-pack=git -c gc.autoDetach=false -c maintenance.autoDetach=false receive-pack`, since git passes no -c setting to the receive-pack of a repository on the same machine, while GitHub, over HTTPS, runs its own and ignores the option. Upkeep isn't turned off, so a command that finds it due takes that much longer, and Poll, Wait and WorkPlan need no change of their own: WorkPlan runs no git, a step's git now ends with its command, and Wait already returns once every step has ended; scope.Check's git only reads, starts no upkeep, and stays as it is. SPEC.md and the README stay as they are, since SPEC already says git commands on the clone run one at a time; the change rests on D-0113, needs no new decision, and changes the trusted base, so a person merges it.

tests.name: TestEveryCallOnTheCloneLeavesNothingRunning
tests.says: With git's upkeep due after every command in the origin and in two clones, and asking to run in the background, every call on the clone that starts it (Fetch, Commit, Push, Record, Finish, PushCommit, PushLease, and another watcher's clone reading a run it has to fetch) has ended, upkeep and all, when it returns: for a while after, nothing in the origin or either clone changes.

tests.name: TestNothingWritesToARepositoryOnceWaitReturns
tests.says: With git's upkeep due and steps running at once, two issues drafted, built and merged together, and then two more, leave the origin and the clone unchanged for a while after each poll and Wait return.

tests.name: TestNothingWritesToARepositoryAfterWorkPlanOrAPoll
tests.says: With git's upkeep due, the plan of issues whose test failed its cleanup in #170, worked through WorkPlan and polls until its first two issues have been drafted, built and merged, leaves the origin and the clone unchanged for a while after each WorkPlan and each poll returns.
